fact: Djibouti launched its National Summary Data Page (PNRD) under the IMF e-GDDS on 12 June 2025 at the Central Bank, built by Central Bank, INSTAD and Budget Ministry staff with the IMF and AfDB, publicly accessible worldwide and hosted on the Djibouti Open Data Platform.

The IMF says Djibouti launched its National Summary Data Page, a portal publishing national accounts, prices, government operations, debt, monetary and external-sector statistics compiled by multiple statistical agencies.
